subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these exact fourteen upstream GitHub Action revisions for workflows that handle repository tokens, release credentials, and OpenAI keys?
rationale: The patch is mechanically consistent, but accepting new third-party executable workflow code in secrets-bearing jobs is a repository security-boundary decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Review and accept the pinned updates
options.body: Verify the upstream release diffs and commit provenance for the fourteen action pins, then merge once the required checks complete.

options.title: Split the sensitive action upgrades
options.body: Land low-risk setup and labeling updates separately while keeping token-, release-, Docker-, and Codex-action changes for a narrower security review.

options.title: Pause the batch
options.body: Close or defer this grouped Dependabot update if the team does not want to accept these action revisions together.

recommendation.title: Review and accept the pinned updates
recommendation.body: Verify the upstream release diffs and commit provenance for the fourteen action pins, then merge once the required checks complete.
